1: Armed with a wetsuit, a speargun, and a single cat, this man being chased by a horde of the infected was just an ordinary lawyer not long ago.
2: Just days after a mysterious virus swallowed Spain whole, the streets are overrun with rabid, rampaging infected.
3: Left all alone in an abandoned town, will he actually manage to make it across the sea alive?
4: On Christmas night in Galicia, Spain, a lawyer named Manel and his wife Julia are playing with his nephew at his sister Belén's house.
5: All his nephew really wants to see is their cat, Lúculo.
6: However, on the drive back home, Julia's expression grows tense behind the wheel.
7: The moment their skidding car comes to a stop on the road, an oncoming truck slams straight into them.
8: Having lost his wife in that crash, Manel is living all alone with his cat Lúculo a year later.
9: Day after day, news of an unidentified virus pours out of the television.
10: As the TSJ virus, which reportedly originated in an abandoned Russian lab, spreads, Europe is even considering closing its borders.
11: Manel's mind, however, is elsewhere as he tries to sell the Corinto, the sailboat he used to ride with his wife.
12: Yet when Manel steps down into the cabin, his eyes fall upon the bracelet his wife used to cherish.
13: Meanwhile, panic buying has begun at the supermarkets, leaving the shelves increasingly bare.
14: Although the government announces that every case is under control, Manel attaches a GPS tracker to Lúculo's collar.
15: That night, he gets a video call from his sister Belén.
16: The next morning, Manel heads to the airport holding Lúculo in his arms.
17: Over the radio comes continuous news of a mutation with an extremely short incubation period.
18: At the crowded Vigo Airport, Manel is set to board a flight bound for Gran Canaria.
19: Suddenly, right in front of the boarding gate, passengers are pulled aside one by one.
20: On the departure board, flights are switched to canceled one after another.
21: A civil security alert pops up on his phone, followed by an urgent call from Belén.
22: As Manel escapes the airport amid gunshots and screams, news of the Vigo Airport incident plays over the car radio.
23: Manel barely makes it into his car, only to find the highway completely jammed as far as the eye can see.
24: Forced to abandon his vehicle, Manel carries Lúculo across the open fields to walk back home.
25: At the entrance to his neighborhood, however, soldiers have set up a guarded quarantine tunnel.
26: Inside the tunnel, Manel spots people in hazmat suits pinning someone down.
27: Back home that night, as Manel is haunted by memories of the car crash, a video call comes in from his sister.
28: With news breaking that Munich, Germany is under lockdown, the videos on his phone grow increasingly horrific.
29: At last, the government's state-of-emergency alert blares out.
30: Now that a state of emergency has finally been declared, Manel rushes to the supermarket and runs into terrified shoppers.
31: After barely managing to fill his backpack, Manel stops by a gas station on his way home.
32: Just then, an infected person lunges at a police officer.
33: As the infected mauls the officer, Manel fights back with nothing but a windshield squeegee.
34: Instead of thanking him, the bitten officer points his gun at Manel, who barely manages to get away.
35: While a government address plays in the background, Manel watches instructional videos and begins turning his house into a fortress.
36: He puts up sharp iron spikes on the balcony and even bolts steel plates onto the front door.
37: He also installs a security camera right outside the entrance.
38: While his neighbors board military buses to evacuate, Manel chooses to stay behind with Lúculo and watches from hiding behind his window.
39: That night, soldiers come pounding on Manel's front door.
40: Eventually forced to venture out for food, Manel puts on a wetsuit to protect himself from bites and grabs his speargun.
41: He breaks the glass door of an empty house to get inside, only to find the refrigerator completely empty.
42: In one of the houses, however, he runs into someone unexpected—his elderly neighbor Gabriela, who uses a wheelchair.
43: The old woman knows the ins and outs of the entire neighborhood like the back of her hand.
44: Every single house she points out yields a stash of canned food.
45: Manel even discovers a motorcycle in a garage, and bread appears on Gabriela's dining table for the first time in ages.
46: Next up is a house marked with a hazard sign, which Manel enters step by step with his speargun raised.
47: After a startled young man bolts away, Manel finds a pantry packed with canned goods and holds a candlelight dinner with Gabriela that night.
48: Later that evening, Manel leaves a voice message for his sister.
49: After the nightmare of that fateful day returns once more, Manel wakes up to the sound of Gabriela's voice coming through the walkie-talkie.
50: A survivors' broadcast begins playing over the radio.
51: By the next morning, Manel is all packed and ready to leave.
52: When Gabriela fails to answer his repeated calls, Manel rushes over to her house.
53: A single note is left sitting on the dining table.
54: Refusing to become a burden, the elderly woman had chosen to pass on first.
55: The very moment he lays Gabriela to rest and steps out onto the street, an infected attacks him.
56: As the infected chases him right onto the roof of a car, Manel aims his speargun with trembling hands.
57: After taking down the infected in a desperate struggle, Manel places the man's ID card from his wallet onto his chest before returning home to leave a message for his sister.
58: Putting Lúculo onto the motorcycle, Manel finally leaves home and rides past an abandoned military checkpoint.
59: Just then, a horde of the infected pours out from the woods.
60: Even after he speeds through a campsite, the infected relentlessly stay on his tail.
61: His motorcycle hits a corpse lying in the road and goes tumbling straight to the ground.
62: As the infected close in again, Manel scoops up Lúculo and sprints down the hill.
63: Dodging an infected climbing over the wire fence, he runs to the very end of the dock where the Corinto used to be moored.
64: Finding the dock completely empty, Manel grabs some gear from a storage shed.
65: He dives into the sea and climbs aboard a bloodstained boat.
66: Just as he barely gets the engine started, blood begins seeping out from under the cabin door.
67: As Manel drifts among floating corpses on the pitch-black night sea, the beam of a searchlight approaches him.
68: A massive cargo ship pulls Manel aboard, and its crew gathers around the unexpected guest.
69: Serving as the interpreter is Viktor Pritchenko, a firefighting helicopter pilot from Ukraine.
70: Unable to sleep that night, Manel looks out the porthole and spots people waving their hands outside.
71: The next morning, survivors are gathered on the deck of the red cargo ship.
72: To Captain Ushakov, Manel is nothing more than a useful technician, while Manel secretly searches the ship for the people who vanished.
73: In the dead of night, Manel puts on his wetsuit and sneaks through the interior of the ship.
74: Down in a lower-deck workshop, what Manel discovers are men locked inside iron cages.
75: Just then, an armed crew member bursts into the room.
76: At that critical moment, Pritchenko lunges at the crewman.
77: The two of them secretly lower a small boat and escape the cargo ship.
78: Although the pair reaches the beach at dawn, pilot Viktor Pritchenko is bleeding from a gunshot wound suffered during their escape.
79: After finding an abandoned car, Manel speeds toward a hospital that has a helipad.
80: Passing collapsed bridges and smoking factories, he finally reaches the hospital only to find its helipad completely empty.
81: Just then, an infected leaps onto the car, and Manel uses a gun he found inside the vehicle to shoot down the swarming horde.
82: Supporting Pritchenko, he makes his way into the dark hospital.
83: While searching for medicine, Manel hears the voices of children coming from beyond an air vent.
84: Following the voices, Manel walks down a blood-spattered corridor.
85: Suddenly, a pack of the infected charges from behind, trapping him in a dead-end hallway just as someone holding a lantern calls out to him.
86: Hiding inside the hospital are a nurse named Lucía, a nun, and three orphaned children.
87: Looking down from the rooftop into the courtyard, they see a helicopter sitting completely intact.
88: That night, the group sits together around the glow of candlelight.
89: Realizing this is the exact hospital where his wife passed away a year ago, Manel walks toward the room she stayed in that day.
90: Standing before the empty bed, Manel recalls the day he lost his wife right after they had been arguing in the car.
91: Up on the rooftop, his phone finally catches a weak signal and receives a video message sent by his sister.
92: Just then, armed men begin approaching the hospital.
93: The group makes their way through a smoke-filled boiler room tunnel.
94: However, a door warped by the intense heat refuses to budge.
95: Right as they barely manage to break the door open, one member of their group gets bitten.
96: In the midst of the chaos, one of the children goes missing, prompting Manel to search the dark storage room.
97: Having found the child in the darkness, Manel holds his breath and waits for the infected to pass by.
98: Manel's plan is to use a wire-mesh cart, hiding inside it as they push straight through the horde of infected toward the helicopter.
99: As the helicopter finally lifts off the ground, Manel grabs hold of the dangling ladder.
100: At that very moment, a phone call comes in from his sister Belén.
101: Could even the Canary Islands, their very last hope, have fallen as well, leaving the story to continue in a sequel?
102: This Amazon Prime Spanish original, Apocalypse Z: The Beginning of the End, is based on the bestselling novel by Manel Loureiro.
103: If you were in his shoes, would you keep flying to the Canary Islands or turn back around—let us know in the comments!
